Department of Pharmacy，Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University，Qingdao 266034，China)［Abstract］ Objective To investigate the clinical characteristics and treatment of hyperkalemia caused by tacrolimus after liver transplantation． Methods Clinical data of one patient diagnosed with hyperkalemia induced by tacrolimus following liver transplantation were collected and retrospectively analyzed． Results The concentration of tacrolimus was elevated after addition of voriconazole，and the risk of hyperkalemia was increased when potassium-sparing diuretics was used． Conclusion Tacrolimus blood concentration，liver and kidney function，as well as electrolytes should be closely monitored after voriconazole is used． Moreover，the dose of tacrolimus should be adjusted timely and try to avoid combination use of drugs that induce hyperkalemia．
